newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei futures end up on Dow, gains limited.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei futures end up on Dow, gains limited.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures received a strong boost from the Dow's 74-point overnight rise on Tuesday, but dealers said further gains were likely to be slow ahead of the September contract's expiry at the end of the week.

"The Dow has gained more than 100 points in two days. We might have a correction tomorrow," said a dealer with a Japanese futures house. "I would rather go short (on the September Nikkei) around the 20,590 level."
He said dollar/yen levels were unlikely to have much impact on the market unless the dollar broke above long-standing resistance at 109.50 yen.
But a dealer with a U.S. institution said the dollar's firm stand above 109.30 yen in early Asian trade on Tuesday had underpinned Nikkei cash and futures markets.

Nikkei 255 September futures finished 15 points off their intra-day high of 20,590 against a previous settlement at 20,255. The December contract, which saw about half the turnover of September, ended at 20,590 against 20,260.
"The spread is so narrow that there's not much premium for people who have short September positions to roll over to December," said the Japanese house dealer.
